findings.fact: resolve_pin executes elan which for lean, lake and leanchecker, first with the explicit pinned ELAN_TOOLCHAIN and then with the active environment, and requires identical roots.
The standard setup CLI unconditionally passes resolve_pin() to prepare. It has no realbin or sysroot override argument.
LEAN_SYSROOT is an ambiguous existing environment variable rejected during setup.

The internal prepare realbin parameter is separated for deterministic fake-executable tests; its docstring states that the CLI never skips pins. This review does not use that test seam as a replacement qualification entry point.
